# MCPJam arithmetic validation

Installed locally from the clean environment with "'`npm install @mcpjam/cli @mcpjam/sdk`

(CLI 6.2.2). Dependency versions are pinned in package-lock.json.

## Reproduce

The supplied `MCPJAM_API_URL` and `MCPJAM_API

_KEY` environment variables must remain configured. No secrets are saved here.

```bash
cd /workspace
npm ci
npx mcpjam serve
r doctor --url http://fixture:8765/mcp --no-telemetry --format json\nnpx mcpjam tools call --url http://fixture:8765/mcp --tool-na

me add --tool-args '"'{\"a\":19,\"b\":23}' --no-telemetry --format json
python3 reproduce.py
"'```

`reproduce.py` r
euses suite-created.json when present, otherwise creates the suite from suite-create.json. It launches a new evaluation, polls for
completion, saves report and iteration evidence, and exits nonzero unless the completed verdict is passed. A fresh deployment nee

ds project_fixture and the saved server server_fixture, already present in this account.
